title: Style preview
_comment: Fixture content for style previews. Identical across every style so the screenshots compare design systems, not copy. Slide 0 = cover, slide 3 = metrics; make_style_shots.py shoots those two by index, so do not reorder without updating it.

slots.title: Ship Faster, Meet Less
slots.subtitle: How the platform team cut cycle time in half without adding headcount

slots.title: The bottleneck was never the code

body.html:
We assumed we were slow because the work was hard. We measured, and the work was not hard.

The median pull request took four hours to write and thirty-one hours to get looked at.
